items.text: Hey everyone!
Today’s a big one: Unholy Fusion, CloverPit’s first DLC, is officially live, alongside the free 1.4 update for the base game!
The DLC was just shadow-dropped (👀) during the Triple-i Initiative showcase, along with a brand-new trailer, and it brings a strange new addition to your cell: the Surgery Machine!

With the help of that bloody device, you can now fuse charms together into a single, more powerful one, giving you the possibility to create even more broken combos. Besides the new fusion charms, we’ve been adding plenty of other surprises to the game - if you thought you had seen all the pit could offer, think again!

Even if you don’t grab the DLC, we’ve got something new for you!
The base game just got an upgrade with the 1.4 ‘Leaderboards’ update:
Online leaderboards are now live! You can finally prove your builds are the most pit-broken
Online leaderboards are separate for normal mode, hard mode, and for versions with and without DLC. However you fancy playing, you’ll find a way to compete!

And because it’s nicer to celebrate with others, we’ve bundled CloverPit with the fantastic peeps of Button Mash and Polden Publishing, who just released Final Sentence - a mashup of Battle Royal and typing game - during the Triple-i Initiative.
The bundle is “Complete the Set”, so you’ll get a discount even if you already own CloverPit!

See you in the pit 👋
Matteo & Lorenzo from Panik Arcade

items.text: Hey everyone!

Update 1.3 is officially live, and we want to give a massive thank you to everyone who shared feedback after the Hard Mode Update. This update mainly implements a bunch of changes based on your feedback to improve the difficulty curve in Hard Mode, some charms as well as smaller quality of life improvements!
The full patch notes are available here, but here’s a breakdown of some of the biggest changes:
A smoother (and fairer) Hard Mode: The deadline no longer jumps to a brutal flat 2x, it now scales gradually. It should be much nicer!
Memory Cards & Rainbow Cards reworked: We’ve rebalanced the whole memory system:
Rainbow holographic cards are now permanent. Once unlocked, they’re yours forever.
Memory packs only spawn the cards you don’t have in holo yet, making completing the collection feel way better.
Hardcore Mode now rewards double the memory packs.
Old Wounds got a full redesign: it now makes every deadline 50% easier.
Charms and cigarettes: We buffed some charms (bricks and wood), and… CIGARETTES GOT A REBALANCE!
They’re guaranteed to appear in the shop once unlocked, start cheaper, but now they get +1 ticket more expensive each time you buy them (until the deadline resets). Balance!
Accessibility upgrades: We’ve added a new setting to reduce flashes and improved text visibility on posters for color-blind players. Thanks for flagging this!
And a couple of smaller polish fixes!
This update should make Hard Mode feel tougher in a way that feels fair and progression smoother. We hope you enjoy those changes, and as usual, we’d love to hear what you think.

On a side note, we are very excited to announce that the mobile port of CloverPit is available RIGHT NOW! It’s the full CloverPit experience available as a premium app, and you can watch the trailer here:
That’s all for now! See you in the pit 👋
Matteo & Lorenzo from Panik Arcade

releases.displayName: Hotfix for the Hard Mode Update drops next week!

items.text: Hey everyone!

First things first: thank you to everyone who shared feedback on the Hard Mode Update! Hearing about your experience is massively helpful for us (we’re a small team to read all your comments), and we heard you loud and clear; a few things definitely needed some tuning.

We’ve been hard at work since launch, and we’re happy to say a hotfix is coming next Wednesday. You can expect a smoother difficulty curve in Hard Mode, charm adjustments (yes, cigarettes are back), a new system for memory cards, and general balance tweaks and fixes.
We really take your feedback to heart, so if you’d like to try these changes before the official release, you can test them now on our open beta branch.

notes.title: How to access the beta branch

items.text: Go to your Steam Library and right-click on CloverPit
Select Properties
Open the Betas tab
In the Beta Participation dropdown, choose “Beta_Test”
If you want to revert to the default branch, just follow the same instructions and select “None” in the Beta Participation dropdown.

And lastly… a little bonus news: we’ve partnered with a wonderful porting team, and the mobile version of CloverPit launches on December 17th! The Pit will soon be able to follow you everywhere. No escape… only debts.
That’s all for now! More soon, and we’ll see you next week!
See you in the pit,
Matteo & Lorenzo from Panik Arcade

releases.displayName: Hard Mode Update OUT NOW - celebrating 1 million copies sold!

items.text: Hi everyone,

We just want to say it again, THANK YOU so much for all your incredible support! We still can’t believe how the launch went… like… WE’VE OFFICIALLY SOLD 1 MILLION COPIES!!! What?! 🤯 We are truly in shock and deeply grateful to all of you who have supported us on this wild ride!
Of course, we haven’t just been celebrating! We’ve also been hard at work cooking up a big new update.
The Hard Mode Update (v1.2) is now live, and you can play it right now! It adds our most requested feature yet: even harder challenges.

Introducing HARD MODE: So many of you asked for more challenges, and here you go! Once you win a run with a memory card, you’ll unlock the option to take it on again in Hard Mode, featuring double the deadline amount! Winning during hard mode will now make the memory card rainbow, instead of having to win with that memory card 3 times - wild! This applies to all memory cards, so there’s plenty of new, super-tough stuff to test your skills.

Since launch, we’ve received a ton of thoughtful feedback about game balance. We’ve reworked loads of charms, values, and other little details to make everything smoother and fairer. Thank you all for helping us fine-tune the game!
The game now does a better job at communicating goals and endgame challenges. We’ve also made a bunch of small bug fixes and UX tweaks to make things clearer and more enjoyable overall.
You can view the full patchnote here, and that’s it for now. We hope you enjoy this new update!
See you in the pit 👋
– Matteo & Lorenzo from Panik Arcade

items.text: GAMEPLAY

Hourglass’effect has been changed as it was the most useless thing ever seen in the entire universe. Now it alternates between growing the symbols and pattern multipliers at the end of each deadline, but it takes 1 extra space. It’s really strong and do not argue against me, OK??!?!?! You will need to use ur big brain between using this or the megaphone or the nuke button. They keep me prisoner in a cell under the Pacific Ocean! Please call for help!
Hourglass now costs a bit more and it’s rare. Nothing special to read here. Please continue reading :)

Added a safeguard to prevent infinity value on patterns value, to avoid crashes. The patterns will be clamped to max value: 1.7976931348623157E+308
Fixed cloverfield tickets bonus. It only granted half of it
Fixed items appearing small in stats screen after death/victory
Fixed localization issues as per player feedback
Rotten pepper now works as it should: doesn’t reset if you continue the previous run after closing the game.

releases.displayName: 300,000 copies sold in 4 days !!!! And first patch available 👀

items.text: Hey everyone,
First off, a MASSIVE THANK YOU to everyone who bought and played our game.
CloverPit has gone viral since launch on Friday, and it’s all thanks to your support!!
300,000 copies sold in just 4 days, and we’re just two little Italian devs… mamma mia, this is a dream come true!
And can you believe it? Most of the top streamers picked up our game, and at one point, we even had more Twitch viewers than Fortnite. Never in our wildest dreams.

Secondly, we want you to know that we’re closely reviewing all your feedback, both here and on our Discord. We’re working hard to address issues and improve the game. In fact, our first patch is available right now! Along with fixes, we’re also adding a fan-requested feature: the slot machine's animation speeds up when those crazy combos kick in 🔥
You can see all the changes in the patchnote here.
Finally, a quick word of warning: there are scam games out on iOS and Android pretending to be CloverPit. They’re total rip-offs (and possibly dangerous!). If you spot one, please report it.
For now, CloverPit is only available on PC via Steam. If we ever release on mobile 👀 you’ll hear it from us first - so don’t fall for the scammers.
That’s all for today, keep an eye on this page for patch news!
We love you more than an ATM loves money,
– Matteo & Lorenzo from Panik Arcade
Hey all,
We hope you’re as excited for launch day as we are! Just over three weeks until the 26th! Ahhhhhh!

Now, as you know today was our original launch date, which had to move due to a certain game *cough silksong cough* launching the day after, and we’re super grateful for the response we’ve had from you all. We’d like to thank you for your patience and understanding, so we’ve decided to treat you all to a big demo update as we couldn’t leave you with nothing today, could we! ♥️ This experience is now much closer to the 1.0 build, so you can get more of a taste in the run-up to launch.
Here are all the updates to go check out!
💎Steam achievements!
🍋 4 new extra charm modifiers with powerful effects!
💰 Charms rebalanced
🍒The Red button and energy charges have been completely overhauled
📱Updated some phone abilities
🍀New localisation
🎮Optimised on Steam Deck
🎰Twitch integration for Twitch partners or affiliated
👀Updated P L O T
🔔A bunch of quality of life features (such as the ability to resize the windowed game and more settings), polish, and ironing for a smoother experience!
We hope you enjoy this new update and the few more weeks of the demo before the big day…
Talk soon and see you in the pit
